description: SINIR+ solid waste management information is published by Ministério do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima. SINIR+ combines statistical and spatial information for national solid-waste management. Its stated coverage is Brazil; national, subnational and facility information. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. It is an information portal; access to each underlying series must be checked separately. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
